title: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee: Return-Not-Refunded Claims Filed by the Buyer
content:
**Northgate Marketplace Guarantee — return not refunded.** Under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, a buyer whose return the seller has not refunded may file a guarantee claim with the claim reason return not refunded on the item line concerned. The claim records the order, the item line, the units it covers and the amount claimed, and is dated the day it is filed; it then waits for the seller's response period and Northgate's decision, and filing it refunds nothing.

**Card-dispute exclusion for these claims.** For a return-not-refunded claim on an order paid with an external card, and only for such a claim, no Northgate Card dispute can stand on the order's charge, so the card-dispute exclusion is met by the order's own payment record; a not-as-described claim on such an order follows its own policy, and every other claim, including any claim on an order paid with a Northgate Card, is still not accepted while the buyer has a card dispute on the same order.

**When the figure is fixed.** Where the order carries exactly one return-not-refunded claim whose claim record shows no decision, the amount claimed for an unrefunded return is fixed only after that claim, if its seller response period has run out, the seller has not refunded every one of its claimed units and its claimed line carries exactly one return request, carries a decision on its claim record; where that claim is referred to a human representative under its own policy, the filing is referred too and nothing is filed. Where the order carries exactly one seller-unresponsive claim whose claim record shows no decision, the amount claimed for an unrefunded return is not fixed until that claim, if its seller response period has run out, the seller has not refunded every one of its claimed units and its claimed line carries no return request, carries a decision on its claim record; where that claim is referred to a human representative under its own policy, the filing is referred too and nothing is filed. Where the order carries exactly one return request the seller answered with a refund without return and that request's line carries exactly one return request, the amount claimed for an unrefunded return is not fixed before that line carries a return refund for the request's units; where that request is referred to a human representative under its own policy, the filing is referred too and nothing is filed.

**Nothing to claim.** Where the amount claimed for an unrefunded return comes to zero there is nothing to claim and no claim is filed.

**How the claim is filed.** The buyer files this claim in person: the agent unlocks the customer's own tool `file_return_refund_claim_24f7de0f` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One run records the buyer's confirmed guarantee-claim request on the order and opens the claim with the claim reason `return_not_refunded`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `market_order_id` | the reference number of the Northgate Marketplace order the claim is filed on, as the buyer's marketplace order lookup shows it (text) |
| `line_event_id` | the reference number of the item line of that same order the claim concerns, as the order history lookup shows it (text); it must be an item line of that order |
| `units` | the number of units of that line the claim covers, a whole number of at least 1 |
| `amount_claimed_usd` | the amount claimed in US dollars, a positive number with exactly two decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** On success the tool answers "Guarantee claim <claim_reference> filed on <market_order_id> (request <request_reference>): return_not_refunded, line <line_event_id>, <units> unit(s), USD <amount>." The claim reference in that receipt is the sign that the claim is on record, and the buyer sees the new claim on the order straight away. It answers with an error when the order is not found, when the line is not an item line of that order, when the units are not a whole number of at least 1, or when the amount is not positive with exactly two decimal places.
